text: Closing. Landed on local main: 3a7fc0cf (corrections) and 96101943 (cold-review fold). Acceptance: (1) README states the distortion/facet/intrusion outputs have no efficacy evidence, pointing to WogDiagnostic (embed-bench/README.md) and the unrun external-floor calibration court; (2) grakern note matches build.sbt:251-263 and module count matches build.sbt (24 = 16 allModules :490 + 8 jvmOnlyModules :510); (3) lexical-baseline statement corrected with citations (wog-minilm-comparison.txt; study log "Diagnosis 2", result :181); (4) tools/recall-study/README.md, agreement.py and the RecallToVideo.scala comment no longer call agreement the primary outcome or judge of record; (5) commit body of 3a7fc0cf lists three retired-phrase greps, all empty outside dated plans; (6) sbt -batch embedBench/compile scalafmtCheckAll exit 0 and docs-site npm run verify:examples exit 0 (13 examples) at 3a7fc0cf; after the fold, embedBench/corpusIntake compile + scalafmtCheck success. Disposition: ClockRepair production integration (landed 2026-09-19) verified in code; no active doc still denies it; the shuffle and prior-scale ablation are labelled reconstruction/sensitivity diagnostics, not bias corrections. Separate fresh-context cold review of 3a7fc0cf: all criteria met, seven minor findings, all folded in 96101943. Follow-up for docs-site pages: bd-01M31TQTBMBGEAS9A666B5MPA6.
